shang_investigation.context: Historical documentary pyromancy on bone/shell, distinct from tossing modern objects. No procurement, burning, crack-making or physical experiment required.
shang_investigation.records: A source-specific reference may record preface/date/diviner, charge, expressed alternatives, prognostication and verification only when actually present. Missing in an excerpt is not proof of absence on the original artifact.
shang_investigation.comparison_leads: 9A/B,20A/B and22A/B are useful contrasted statements;19A/B are differently conditioned settlement cases on successive source-labelled days, not a same-day simple negation.24A/B concern different propositions despite shared numbering.
shang_investigation.uncertainty: Keep20A action uncertainty, supplied diviner names/romanization, partial dates and editorial parentheses distinct. Source sexagenary day labels do not establish an absolute Gregorian date.
shang_investigation.limits: No Chinese glyph transcription/translation, fragment joins, artifact authentication, physical crack classification, numerical probability or actual outcome prediction verified. No recorded outcome invented from the charge.
shang_investigation.provenance: AFE anthology pp8,11–12 are its cited locators; individual artifact inventory numbers and original corpus cross-references remain a source-freeze refinement. Curatorial artifact date/material is independent evidence, not an excerpt-to-object link.

contemporary_investigation.inventory: No executable contemporary set frozen. Obtain yronwode actual pp71–89 with source-defined object roles, face/orientation, surface and exceptions.
contemporary_investigation.geometry: Lithomancy integer centers, exact distance and raw-user placement/hash helpers may be reused only as separately declared editorial geometry. Howard nearest-anchor semantics do not transfer to bones.
contemporary_investigation.symbolism: Per-object and positional meanings must belong to a named authored method. No universal role table, nearest-first rule or combined fortune inferred from chapter headings or commercial photographs.
contemporary_investigation.casting: Manual typed placement before any optional synthetic distribution. A toss metaphor does not define face/position probabilities. Do not import Rune or Geomancy sampling/algebra.

southern_african_investigation.separation: Specific Ngwaketse/Tswana museum account, Tsonga collection and Tsonga1939 archive are individually attributed; none stands for all Southern African practice.
southern_african_investigation.living_context: Personal selection, community context, training/initiation and interpretive authority remain source-dependent. Documentary metadata is not a claim to be a practitioner or permission to expose private knowledge.
southern_african_investigation.state_space: Phansi64 combinations and yronwode catalogue Hakata16 results describe insufficiently inspected configurations. Preserve both as leads; do not force a common binary model or silently correct either.
southern_african_investigation.access: No community contact/message sent. Public source facts can be audited now; any later restricted materials require their actual access terms. No hypothetical approval requirement added to this audit.
southern_african_investigation.language: Mtebule original language/transcript and licence are uninspected. No unsupported translation or current universal validity claimed.

candidate_first_scope.choice: Bounded documentary Shang translated-charge reference and typed inscription-structure comparison using rights-compliant original factual summaries of the thirteen AFE labels.
candidate_first_scope.justification: Directly inspectable complete bounded text and contrasting references offer more verified functionality than an uninspected contemporary spatial system. This is a documentary output, not a charm toss simulator.
candidate_first_scope.source_freeze: Recheck exact HTML/source edition/rights and author independent concise factual case notes before any executable catalog. Preserve every label, uncertainty and supplied date/diviner separately.
candidate_first_scope.meaningful_output: Select known historical case IDs, show available source structure, compare explicitly sourced charge polarity/conditions and absent/unavailable layers, retain user annotations and produce exact offline JSON/Markdown replay.
candidate_first_scope.alternative: Contemporary authored manual charm comparison only after actual object/position/example pages support a complete bounded system; maintain separate profile/output from Shang records.

independent_fixture_opportunities: Freeze all thirteen AFE source labels and independent concise expected facts before production code, without copying the complete translation corpus.
Verify9/20/22 contrasts,19 conditional/day distinction and24 non-complementarity; labels alone are not an algorithm.
Check source-present versus excerpt-missing date/diviner/action/prognostication/outcome fields; never fill missing values by inference.
Verify exact source romanization and day-index labels without absolute calendar conversion or claims to translate original graphs.
Keep original artifact identifiers unknown unless independently linked; do not attach a museum bone image to a translation by topic similarity.
If a contemporary set becomes feasible, author independent per-object/spatial/face fixtures from that one source; existing Lithomancy geometry alone is not symbolic verification.

proposed_contract.documentary: Named immutable witness; selected known case IDs; explicit user/source/editorial fields; source locators and rights; optional raw Unicode annotations; unknown fields explicit. No source-free charge generation or personalized prophecy.
proposed_contract.contemporary: Separate named object-role profile, manual declared positions/orientations and explicit unknowns only after source freeze. Bound geometry separately from meanings; no physical animal material needed.
proposed_contract.reuse: Pure strict JSON, raw Unicode, immutable registry, canonical hashes and replay/report helpers. Reuse exact geometry only for independently sourced contemporary conditions, never Shang epigraphy.
proposed_contract.offline: No LLM, image recognition, external API, random toss, physical crack simulation or new dependency required for documentary core.

Source uncertainty, original-vs-excerpt missing evidence, cultural provenance and translation/image rights remain explicit.
Offline strict JSON/Markdown, raw text preservation, portable source/profile/request hashes, deterministic full replay and supported/experimental/unsupported matrix.
